name: Kilobat Pro for students
summary: Free one-year Pro license for eligible students, covering two Macs.
description: Kilobat is a proprietary macOS application for understanding network activity and diagnosing connection problems. Eligible students can request a free one-year Pro license and request another year while still studying.

benefits.description: Pro license for one year on two Macs, renewable while studying.

eligibility.summary: Students aged 13 or older in a degree-granting course, including a diploma-granting coding bootcamp.
criteria: Request from a school email address.
unknowns: Geographic availability is not specified on the official page.

notes: Official page checked for offer and request terms; application status, geographic availability and deadline are not specified.

applicationProcess: Email the support address from a school email address to request a key; the official page links to that address.
limitations: The desktop application runs on Mac.
One-year license; renewal requires an additional school-email request while still studying.
The student offer is not listed as a GitHub Student Developer Pack offer.
